Estimate the joint distribution of given and true labels

Source: R/joint.R
estimate_joint.Rd

Normalises the calibrated confident joint so that it sums to one (Northcutt et al., 2021, Eq. 3 and Algorithm 2). Entry [i, j] estimates the proportion of examples that have given label i and true label j.

Usage

estimate_joint(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Labels or an object holding labels and predicted probabilities. See Description.

...

Passed to label_inputs(): for example pred_probs when x is a label vector, or truth when x is a data frame.

Value

A square matrix with dimension names given and true that sums to one. Its row sums equal the observed class proportions.

References

Northcutt, C., Jiang, L., & Chuang, I. (2021). Confident learning: Estimating uncertainty in dataset labels. Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research, 70, 1373–1411. doi:10.1613/jair.1.12125

Examples

sim <- simulate_label_noise(n = 500, seed = 1)
round(estimate_joint(sim, truth = given), 3)
#>      true
#> given     A     B     C     D
#>     A 0.341 0.016 0.013 0.022
#>     B 0.027 0.232 0.018 0.009
#>     C 0.014 0.014 0.165 0.009
#>     D 0.010 0.018 0.008 0.083
